findings.root_cause: server.py /api/start_line endpoint stores GPS but does NOT compute distance/bearing to line

what_is_missing.pin_buoy_bearing_deg: Bearing from boat to pin buoy not computed
what_is_missing.pin_buoy_dist_m: Distance from boat to pin not computed
what_is_missing.pin_rc_bearing_deg: Bearing from boat to comité boat not computed
what_is_missing.pin_rc_dist_m: Distance from boat to comité not computed
what_is_missing.start_line_length_m: Distance between pin and comité not computed
what_is_missing.line_bias_deg: Angle of line vs wind not computed

solution: Add to server.py: distance, bearing, and line-calculation functions called when /api/start_line or /api/position is updated
